# Independent audit: strict parity labels and regular abstract menus


`candidate d832490f406df490`.
Result: **PASS**, with its explicit abstract-menu scope.

The complete lattice set in dimension s=k-1 has exactly k+1 points,
k occupied parities, and s maximal occupied minimal faces. The doubled
edge and the other singleton vertices have precisely the asserted
relative-interior witnesses. Thus these labels attain the strict count
from the independently audited fixed-face theorem.

On E={sum x_i=0}, the affine-independent reference vectors satisfy
sum pi_i v_i=pi-pi_0 for every normalized pi. For arbitrary column
perturbations d_i of norm at most epsilon=1/(4s), the exact balancing
equation is (Id+Delta|E)eta=-Delta pi_0. The operator norm is at most
sqrt(s)epsilon=1/(4sqrt(s))<=1/4, and the right side has norm at most
epsilon. Hence the inverse exists for every menu tuple, eta is unique,
and |eta|<=1/(3s). Each coordinate of pi is consequently in the stated
strictly positive interval. The inverse formula gives continuity and
smoothness on an open neighborhood; no selection theorem is needed.

The uniform bound does not supply common multipliers: varying one
menu vector while holding the others fixed indeed forces that index's
alleged fixed coefficient to vanish, and repeating contradicts
normalization. Full dimensionality of each menu is genuine in E.

The protecting cone identity follows from v_i dot x=x_i and the exact
support function of the Euclidean ball. For A=max x_i, the displayed
lambda_j are nonnegative, sum to one, and their convex combination
of A*1-s*A*e_j equals x. The resulting A>=|x|/sqrt(s(s-1))>=|x|/s
proves the quantitative margin 3|x|/(4s). This certifies a cover,
not only pairwise antipodal avoidance. A cone and its negative can
share only zero, and the intersection of all cones is zero by summing
their defining inequalities.

Every witness is essential: v_i fails the jth protecting inequality
for j!=i because their inner product is -1/s, whereas its own positive
coordinate (s-1)/s exceeds epsilon|v_i|. Thus the whole set of labels
forms an essential block, whose span is exactly E of dimension k-2.
The improved rank bound is attained without any nonzero common kernel.

The finite rational crosspolytope menus span E at every label, lie
strictly inside the stated perturbation balls, and have the exact
support function delta max_j|x_j-x_s|. Their cone formula, pointedness,
essential labels, adaptive balances and failure of fixed weights all
follow with the displayed constants. The convexified menus retain
finite rational generators; no claim of finitely many points filling
an open set is made.

The source consistently separates actual lattice labels from abstract
response vectors. It does not claim that these menus are realized by
critical cap derivatives, admissible source-body variations, or any
below-target mixed-integer minimizer. Therefore its conclusion blocks
only a count/topology/regularity inference lacking additional geometric
identities; it neither proves nor contradicts OC.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
